cause: Default best-effort routing treated different endpoint roles as interchangeable physical paths. GPS_DATA requests GroundStation, SD-card and FlightController; adaptive selection chose CAN for FC/SD and omitted the radio GroundStation role despite returning success.

policy.selection: For each requested role retain shortest candidates, reuse already chosen physical side if it covers that role, otherwise apply existing adaptive choice among redundant candidates. Deduplicate physical egress.

Reliable best-overlap routing and preferred timesync routing

covered_cases: ActualGPS C ABI packet reaches independent CAN two roles and radio one GroundStation role exactly once, identical packet ID and payload.

ci_seed_fixture_followup.fix: Reuse existing canonical endpoint IDs and metadata. In the isolated GPS child only, remove the generic seeded GPS definition and register the actual RF delivery contract under its existing canonical type ID. Assert SD_CARD ID/description/local flag retained. No production registry weakening or routing changes.

single_candidate_fastpath.cause: The first role planner unnecessarily allocated per-role scratch for packets with only one eligible physical egress. Full default unit campaign passed721 tests but Stage6 correctly rejected5 allocations per two-endpoint packet against the unchanged3-allocation limit.
single_candidate_fastpath.fix: Enter role planning only with morethan one eligible candidate. A sole physical egress retains the original allocation-bounded transit path. Five-line runtime diff, no memory/latency threshold changes.
